attr.title: Gunslugs (experimental APK adaptation)
attr.desc: Experimental Java/libGDX adaptation of owner-supplied Gunslugs Android data for compatible AArch64 Linux handhelds. Automatic screen sizing supports 4:3, 3:2, square and widescreen displays. Device validation varies by firmware.
attr.inst: Place Gunslugs.sh beside gunslugs in your firmware's ports folder. On muOS put gunslugs in /ports and the launcher in /roms/PORTS. Copy your supported APK to gunslugs/gunslugs.apk for first-launch preparation, or use your privately prepared data. Requires 64-bit ARM Linux, compatible graphics, PortMaster, Westonpack and Java 17. Screen size is detected automatically; resolution.txt can override it. No original game content is distributed.
